bhadanta.cp: adj. venerable; reverend. (m.) a venerable person.
bhadanta.p: [Bhadda+anta] (pu) Google Translate Bhazati Kalyana Dhammanti Bhantaw. Maung, 7.76. This is called the 'Gissantadi Gang'. ထေ ရ၊ ⁇ ထ၊ 2. 169. The Alopori sect. Akaranta's real sex. In the work - divided into Bhadanta + Thi. Give it to me, O Lord. နိ တိ၊ Sutta ⁇ 88.] Lord. Good Lord.
a: ဘဇတိ ကလျာဏဓမ္မန္တိ ဘဒန္တော။ မောဂ်၊၇။၇၆။ ယင်းအလို 'ဂစ္ဆန္တာဒိဂိုဏ်း'။ ထေရ၊ ဋ္ဌ၊ ၂။ ၁၆၉။ အလို ပုရိသာဒိဂိုဏ်း။ အကာရန္တပကတိရှိသော ဧကာရန္တပုံလိင်။ အာလုပ်၌-ဘဒန္တ+သိ ဟု ခွဲ။ အို အရှင်ဟု ပေး။ နီတိ၊ သုတ္တ။ ၎၈၈။] အရှင်၊ အရှင်ကောင်း။

[bhadda+anta．bhajati kalyāṇadhammanti bhadanto．，7．76．a ]]gacchantādi]]．thera，ṭṭha，2．169．a purisādi．akārantapakatirhiso ekārantapuṃ．ānitea-bhadanta+si hu ． ahu ．nīti，sutta．488．]
[ဘဒ္ဒ+အန္တ။ ဘဇတိ ကလျာဏဓမ္မန္တိ ဘဒနေ္တာ။ မောဂ်၊၇။၇၆။ ယင်းအလို ''ဂစ္ဆန္တာဒိဂိုဏ်း''။ ထေရ၊ ဋ္ဌ၊ ၂။ ၁၆၉။ အလို ပုရိသာဒိဂိုဏ်း။ အကာရန္တပကတိရှိသော ဧကာရန္တပုံလိင်။ အာလုပ်၌-ဘဒန္တ+သိ ဟု ခွဲ။ အို အရှင်ဟု ပေး။ နီတိ၊ သုတ္တ။ ၄၈၈။]
C: bhadanta：[adj．] venerable; reverend．（m．） a venerable person．
P: Bhadanta，（Bhaddanta） [a secondary adj．formation from address bhaddaṁ （=bhadraṁ） te “hail to thee，＂ cp．“bhaddaṁ vo＂ under bhadda 1] venerable，reverend．mostly in Voc．as address “Sir，holy father＂ etc．，to men of the Order．Voc．sg．bhadante S．I，216 （v．l．bhaddante）; Voc．pl．bhadantā DhA．III，414．-- A contracted form of bhadante is bhante （q．v．）．Note．In case of bhadanta being the corresp．of Sk．*bhavanta （for bhavān） we would suppose the change v›d and account for dd on grounds of pop．analogy after bhadda．See bhante．The pl．Nom．from bhadantā is formed after bhadante，which was felt as a Voc．of an a --stem with --e for --a as in Prk．Māgadhī．（Page 497）

DOP: bhadanta ( and bhaddanta), m. [ AMg bhayanta; BHS bhadanta], a revered person; esp. a member of the Buddhist saṅgha; Vin I 73, 6 (kathaṃ hi nāma ~ā pañcahi ābādhehi phuṭṭhaṃ pabbājessantī ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bhaddantā); 148, 14 (so ce bhikkhussa santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya ahaṃ hi gilāno āgacchatu ~o icchāmi ~assa āgatan ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bhaddanto … bhaddantassa …); III 198, 30 (āgacchatu ~o mayaṃ upaṭṭhahissāmā ti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se bhaddanto); IV 69, 29 (cirassāpi ~ā āgatā ti, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se bhaddantā); M I 374, 18 (~ena tapassinā samaṇassa Gotamassa vyākataṃ); Ja III 143, 25 (amhākaṃ ~aṃ gahetvā vanacarakehi saddhiṃ himavantaṃ yāhī ti); IV 343, 7 (tumhe vihāraṃ gantvā … ~ānaṃ kathaṃ parigaṇhathā ti); V 212, 11 (ayaṃ ~o acchinnacīvaro bhavissati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se bhaddanto); VI 227, 6* (yathā ~o bhaṇati mayhaṃ p’ etaṃ va ruccati, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se bhaddanto); Mil 25, 6 (Milindo rājā āyasmantaṃ Nāgasenaṃ etad avoca kathaṃ ~o ñāyati); 88, 21 (kiṃ mayā pucchitaṃ kiṃ ~ena vissajjitan ti); Sp 815, 15 (nanu bhante asukasmiṃ ca asukasmiṃ ca gāme ~e bhojesuṃ); Dhp-a III 394, 7 (mayaṃ titthiyānaṃ santikā maṅgalaṃ suṇoma ~ā pana tuṇhībhūtā pakkamantī ti, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be bhaddantā); IV 175, 2 (sā itthī n’ eva maṃ esa ~o passati na ālapati, mā naṃ kiñci avacā ti āha); Mhv 29:15; — sg. voc. bhadante, D I 96, 13 (sotthi ~e hotu rañño sotthi ~e hotu rañño ti, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be bhaddante); M I 1, 6 (bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi bhikkhavo ti, ~e ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ; Ps I 14, 28 foll.: ~e ti gāravavacanaṃ etaṃ); Vv 21:7 (ahaṃ ~e caṇḍālī, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be bhaddante); Pv 6:2 (ahaṃ ~e petī ’mhi; Pv-a 33, 4 : theraṃ gāravena ālapati); Th 527 (aṅgārino dāni dumā ~e; cf Th-a II 223, 17 foll.: ~e ti bhaddaṃ ante etassā ti ~e ti ekassa dakārassa lopaṃ katvā vuccati … ~e ti satthu ālapanam eva, paccattavacanaṃ c’ etaṃ ekārantaṃ); Ja IV 330, 23* (kiso ca paṇḍū ca ahaṃ ~e); Sadd 679, 30 (bhaddantasaddassa sabbass’ eva ~e icc ādeso hoti vā ge pare); — see also ehibhadantika, tiṭṭhabhadantika, bhante.
